genesis.8.p1.b1.text: But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark.

genesis.8.p1.b2.text: And God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters began to subside.

genesis.8.p1.b3.text: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens were closed, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

genesis.8.p2.b4.text: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.

genesis.8.p2.b5.text: And the waters continued to recede until the tenth month, and on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains became visible.

genesis.8.p3.b6.text: After forty days Noah opened the window he had made in the ark and sent out a raven …

genesis.8.p3.b7.text: But the dove found no place to rest her foot …

genesis.8.p3.b8.text: … she returned to him in the ark … So he reached out his hand and brought her back inside the ark.

genesis.8.p4.b9.text: And behold, the dove returned to him in the evening with a freshly plucked olive leaf in her beak.

genesis.8.p4.b10.text: So Noah knew that the waters had receded from the earth.

genesis.8.p4.b11.text: And Noah waited seven more days and sent out the dove again, but this time she did not return to him.

genesis.8.p5.b12.text: In Noah’s six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters had dried up from the earth.

genesis.8.p5.b13.text: So Noah removed the covering from the ark and saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

genesis.8.p5.b14.text: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was fully dry.

genesis.8.p6.b15.text: “Come out of the ark, you and your wife, along with your sons and their wives.

genesis.8.p6.b16.text: … so that they can spread out over the earth and be fruitful and multiply upon it.

genesis.8.p6.b17.text: So Noah came out, along with his sons and his wife and his sons’ wives.

genesis.8.p6.b18.text: Every living creature, every creeping thing, and every bird—everything that moves upon the earth—came out of the ark, kind by kind.

genesis.8.p7.b19.text: Then Noah built an altar to the LORD. And taking from every kind of clean animal and clean bird, he offered burnt offerings on the altar.

genesis.8.p7.b20.text: Never again will I curse the ground because of man … And never again will I destroy all living creatures as I have done.

genesis.8.p7.b21.text: As long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease.”
